method: 40 independent setup seeds per matchup by default, every candidate seat rotated against the named opponent policy. Approximate 95% paired Student-t intervals use complete seed-group means, not independent seat games. Incomplete groups excluded from estimates and reported. Fixed modest policy-specific budgets; latency is measured, not equal-time strength. No promotion or confirmation claim.

limitations: Original 30-ticket catalog second visual audit remains open.
Incumbent uses sampled network evaluation; explicit planning-v2 is deterministic joint-ticket collection. Neither is calibrated win probability.
Incumbent root sweeps can exceed requested samples; planning-v2 evaluates each root once and samples no worlds.
Fixed sample budgets are not equal-time comparisons of these policies.
Exhausted supply and caps stay unresolved; no promotion conclusion.
